persona.name: Jordan Kim
persona.summary: Frontend developer with three years of React experience trying to move into backend roles
persona.background: Builds React and TypeScript features at a project-management SaaS company and leads accessibility work. Has written a few Node.js backend-for-frontend endpoints and a small Flask side project. Wants backend roles but knows the evidence is thin.
goals: Present the backend work they have honestly
Understand which backend gaps matter most before applying
frustrations: Resume tools make every application look like a perfect match
Unsure whether to lead with frontend strengths or backend interest
evaluator_notes: Backend evidence is limited to BFF endpoints and a Flask side project
Python is listed and used only in a personal project
No R, Tableau, Power BI, Django, FastAPI, Docker, or AWS evidence

bullets.bullet_text: Build React and TypeScript features for a project-management web app with 50k weekly users
Created a Storybook library of 60 components adopted by 4 product teams
Led an accessibility audit and fixed 120 WCAG 2.1 AA issues across the app
Added Node.js backend-for-frontend endpoints that combine three internal REST APIs for the dashboard page
Wrote Jest and React Testing Library tests that raised frontend coverage from 35% to 70%
Migrated global state from Redux to Redux Toolkit across 14 feature modules
Built responsive marketing pages with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript

projects.description: Personal project to learn backend development

bullets.bullet_text: Built a Flask REST API with SQLite for saving and tagging recipes, with basic pytest tests
Built a browser extension that checks colour contrast against WCAG, with 3,000 installs
